timing: Sequential fresh-process ABBA/BAAB; A/A per compiler/ISA/depth, fixed 128-block comparisons; no favorable retries
builds: GCC and Clang PGO/LTO dotprod; GCC PGO/LTO ordinary NEON; x86 GCC PGO/LTO AVX2
boot: Fresh instance per family; Intel controller excludes both engine core siblings
selection: Evaluate fixed components; retain original PR evidence and all new results; narrow or split review scope based on correctness, portability, assembly and performance without retesting until favorable
production_embedding: normal profile-build default; external EvalFile has the same pinned network
replacement_reason: Patched dirty trees changed build version code and binary layout, including x86; prior timing claims withdrawn. Fixed inputs, budgets and rejection rules retained.
production_profile: One baseline-generated immutable profile per compiler/architecture; both builds in identical source path use that same profile; no training of candidate.
x86_guard: Exact disassembly identity using common profile, before timing
clang_guard: Exact disassembly identity using common profile, before timing
arm_gate: ARM workers may build and run exact checks concurrently; no calibration or candidate timing until the Intel common-profile identity receipt is approved.
profile_warning_policy: GCC source-line location warnings only are recorded and permitted via -Wno-error=coverage-mismatch; GCC retains these counts. Control-flow/counter-count mismatches and missing profiles stop validation. No counter data modified.
